embeds.title: ST Model (November 11, 2025) [General/Model Discussions] model_drop
embeds.description: Hi there. new model drop on dev branch. I wonder how it is, but this is commas iterated ST Model. Hopefully it is not as bad as the last one and is better!

I didn't enable NNLC when using this model, as it limits steering wheel torque on my vehicle, so I haven't enabled it yet.
For reviews I think it’s better to use without NNLC

The yellow light had already disappeared when I drove far towards the traffic light. I only started to slow down gradually when I saw the red light. At that point, the light was red and my speed was between 40 and 60 kilometers per hour.

Based on the fact that the torsional resistance decreased when NNLC was enabled last time, and the correction progress remained at 0, BIN suggested that I disable NNLC first to restore normal operation. I've been trying the model with NNLC disabled ever since.
